title: insonic metadata extraction tools
description: Workspace metadata extractor configuration. Every configured executable has an absolute selected path, exact version and SHA-256. Hash/version qualification happens before extraction, and child processes use hidden noninteractive I/O. Missing or failed extractors record explicit capture outcomes while retaining usable original media.

exiftool.description: Selected embedded-metadata extractor, preserving qualified groups, repeated tags and structured values.

ffprobe.description: Selected complementary stream/container probe, supplying measured source duration and clock facts.

tool.description: One exact local executable selected for metadata extraction.

path.description: Absolute executable path on this machine; executable selection is explicit and never inferred from an ambient PATH.

sha256.description: Expected lowercase SHA-256 of the selected executable bytes.

version.description: Exact expected upstream version reported by the selected executable.

support_files.description: Exact selected support files used by a launcher or interpreter bundle. Each file hash is checked before execution so launcher delegation cannot bypass the pinned package identity.

path.description: Absolute selected support-file path within the installed extractor bundle.

sha256.description: Expected lowercase SHA-256 of this exact support file.

items.description: Optional exact absolute interpreter executable used to run the selected tool script, independently hash-qualified without ambient PATH or shebang lookup.

path.description: Absolute selected support-file path within the installed extractor bundle.

sha256.description: Expected lowercase SHA-256 of this exact support file.

interpreter.description: Optional exact absolute interpreter executable used to run the selected tool script, independently hash-qualified without ambient PATH or shebang lookup.
